text.tspan: Drag the part names from the word bank below
into the numbered slots around the flower.
Match each term to its correct anatomical location.
This SVG simulates the experience using
Use Hint for clues. Check your answers.
• Petals are usually brightly colored to attract pollinators like bees.
• The stamen (male part) includes the filament stalk and pollen-producing anther.
• The pistil (female part) consists of the sticky stigma, the style, and the ovary at the base.
• Sepals protect the flower bud before it opens. The receptacle is the base that holds all parts.
• Look at the arrows and the relative position of each structure in the diagram.

g.text: (Click anywhere on backdrop or X to close)

In a real interactive version, the slots would be filled by dragging the tiles.The pistil is the female reproductive structure. The stamen is the male reproductive structure.Pollen travels from the anther to the stigma during pollination, eventually reaching the ovary.
